name: Azure storage account
short_description: The top-level Azure resource that provides a globally unique namespace for storage data such as blobs, with its own performance tier, redundancy setting and access keys.

evidence.quote: You had to create a storage account yourself, then create a page blob inside it
At the top is the storage account. This is the name space for all your data.
An Azure Storage Account is a container. That's all.
No two storage accounts in the world can share the same name.
They lived inside something called a storage account. Imagine a storage account as a big container.
